newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Many casualties in bomb attack on Pakistan mosque.
newsitem.headline: Many casualties in bomb attack on Pakistan mosque.

text.p: A bomb was hurled at a mosque in Multan city in Pakistan's Punjab province on Wednesday, killing at least one person and injuring 30, witnesses said.
The bombing during evening prayers followed a shooting at a mosque in the provincial capital Lahore in which at least six people were killed.

The bombed Amir Muavia mosque in central Multan, the main city in southern Punjab, is run by the majority Sunni sect of Islam, some of whose militant groups are engaged in a feud with rival militants of the minority Shi'ite sect.
The witnesses the bomb was thrown as worshippers prayed during the last of the five daily Moslem prayers.
There was no immediate information on the identity of the attackers.
